invariants.must_contain: job is to **cast**, not to illuminate
invariants.why: every material in the scene ignores lighting; treating the light as illumination leads to re-adding ambient and re-shading the baked art
ShadowMaterial decouples shadow strength from photometry; a lit floor would retie them and make every light tweak a shadow tweak
uniform face brightness forces a light behind the viewer, which hides every shadow behind its caster; this is arithmetic, not tuning
with autoUpdate on, every draw re-renders a 2048 depth pass, including every frame of a zoom or pan

invariants.must_contain: consumed by the renderer after one frame
invariants.why: needsUpdate is a one-shot request, not a mode; forgetting to set it again leaves the shadow map stale
the light target is not refreshed by anything else; without it the shadow camera keeps aiming at the origin
the shadow frustum must cover the map's diagonal in light space, not its axis-aligned footprint, or the shadow clips at the edge
